fusions.name: Spore Scuff
fusions.desc: Scuffs up spores that deal 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leave each one [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Each enemy hit is slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Harvest the Rot
fusions.desc: A finishing kick that deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Puffball Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Wayside Sporeling
fusions.desc: A bonded sporeling trails you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill you make returns 3 health.
